# `api.jobs.inventory.get_all`

> `GET /job/{jobDisplayId}/inventory` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.inventory.get_all(job_display_id: int) -> list[JobInventoryItem]
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs inventory get_all <job_display_id>
```

``GET /job/{jobDisplayId}/inventory``
